units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:2">Sabb. XII, 2</cite> <he>המְקַרְסֵם</he> he that trims trees.
Shebi. II, 3 מְקַרְסְמִין וכ׳ you may trim trees &c.; [Maim. cut the earsoff, leaving the halms stand].
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:10">Ab. Zar. III, 10</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:7">Peah II, 7</cite> <he>קִרְסְמוּהָ נמלים</he> a field the grain of which ants have bitten off (at the roots); <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 9</cite> <he>השלחן … שנִתְקַרְסְמוּ</he> (Var. <he>שנִתְקַסְּמוּ</he>) a table … which have been cut up (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:1">Kel. XXII, 1</cite> <he>שנפחתו</he>).
